topPRs.title: [Chore] RECA Standard 게임 타입 등록 태스크 추가
topPRs.author: raddaslul
topPRs.body:
배경
- Recyclefarm Carbon Network Sepolia(chainId 82696765)의 Onchain Standard Validator 대기 항목을 해소하기 위해 Standard Cannon/Kona dispute game 구성을 L1PAO 검토 경로로 제출합니다.
- 현재 U19 permissionless 기본값은 respected type 8 및 legacy Cannon type 0 비활성화입니다. 이 태스크는 기존 출금 완료와 valid/invalid challenger 시험 전까지 respected type 1을 유지하면서 0, 1, 8을 함께 등록하는 단계적 예외입니다. Foundation 및 Security Council의 명시적 승인 또는 거절을 요청합니다.
- RECA는 아직 Superchain Registry에 없으므로 배포 아티팩트와 pinned Sepolia fork의 live getter로 검증한 fallback address 파일을 포함합니다.

수정 내역
- `OPCMConfigureStandardGamesV700` 템플릿을 추가해 game type 0, 1, 8을 활성화하고 respected type 1을 유지했습니다.
- 기존 `OPCMUpgradeV700`의 기본 U19 동작을 바꾸지 않는 virtual policy hook을 추가했습니다.
- task 104 구성, calldata, Foundation/Security Council 서명 해시, 15개 DisputeGameFactory 순상태 변경을 문서화했습니다.
- 실제 태스크 calldata와 양쪽 서명 데이터를 고정하는 회귀 fixture를 추가했습니다.

검증
- `forge fmt --check`
- `forge build`
- 신규 calldata/서명 회귀 테스트 통과
- 기존 U19 permissionless 및 permissioned 회귀 테스트를 archive RPC에서 통과
- `simulate-stack sep 104-reca-standard-game-types` 통과
- Foundation 및 Security Council nested Safe 경로 시뮬레이션 통과
- Standard Validator expected errors가 빈 값임을 확인

주의
- 서명 직전 L1PAO, Foundation, Security Council Safe nonce를 다시 조회하고 모든 Safe/domain/message hash를 재생성해야 합니다.
- 이 PR은 검토용 Draft이며 서명 또는 온체인 실행을 수행하지 않습니다.

topPRs.title: eth/064: Swell Mainnet L2 ProxyAdmin transfer to aliased AltLayer Safe
topPRs.author: ZakAyesh
topPRs.body:
## Description

Adds `eth/064-swell-l2pao-transfer`, executing the L2 half of the approved [Maintenance Upgrade Proposal: Swell Ownership Transfer to AltLayer](https://vote.optimism.io/proposals/55157120062626112833592164692393784963640643805353175342472662837980214398880) for Swell Mainnet (chainId 1923).

Using the `TransferL2PAOFromL1` template, the task sends a deposit transaction through the Swell OptimismPortal (`0x758E0EE66102816F5C3Ec9ECc1188860fbb87812`) calling `transferOwnership` on the L2 ProxyAdmin predeploy (`0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000018`), moving it from the aliased current L1PAO (`0x6B1BAE59D09fCcbdDB6C6cceb07B7279367C4E3b`) to the aliased AltLayer Safe:

```
alias(0xa83F1334c6a8Daca576Dc14020d9d2b1b16a8Dfa) = 0xb9501334c6a8Daca576Dc14020d9d2b1b16a9F0b
```

## Notes for reviewers

- **Stacked after `eth/063-swell-l1-ownership-transfers`** (PR #1511): the template asserts the L1 ProxyAdmin owner already equals the unaliased new owner, so a `stateOverrides` entry pre-applies the eth/063 transfer for standalone simulation. eth/063 must merge and execute first.
- Safe nonce overrides are pinned at live values (read 2026-07-30: L1PAO=36 / FUS=62 / SC=60) **+3**, accounting for the READY-TO-SIGN `eth/061` and `eth/062` tasks plus `eth/063`. If those are reordered or cancelled, the hashes must be regenerated.
- Swell was removed from the superchain-registry, so addresses load via `fallbackAddressesJsonPath`, copied from the registry commit immediately before removal and verified on-chain.
- Simulated successfully on both child-safe legs (`foundation`, `council`) and via stacked simulation through this task, with the repo-pinned forge 1.1.0; VALIDATION.md hashes come from those runs.
- Swell's public RPC (`https://swell-mainnet.alt.technology`) now requires auth, so the L2-side deposit simulation per `docs/simulate-l2-ownership-transfer.md` needs an endpoint from AltLayer; post-execution verification can also use https://explorer.swellnetwork.io.

Part of ethereum-optimism/solutions#980.

topPRs.title: eth/065 + sep/104: Ink SystemConfig ownership transfer FOS → FUS
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Description

Transfers ownership of the Ink `SystemConfigProxy` from the **Foundation Operations Safe (FOS)** to the **Foundation Upgrade Safe (FUS)** on both networks, as a follow-up to the completed Gelato → OP Enterprise rollup-operator migration.

Closes ethereum-optimism/solutions#973.

| Task | Chain | SystemConfigProxy | Current owner (signer) | New owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `eth/065-ink-system-config-owner-to-fus` | Ink Mainnet (57073) | `0x62C0a111929fA32ceC2F76aDba54C16aFb6E8364` | FOS `0x9BA6e03D8B90dE867373Db8cF1A58d2F7F006b3A` (5-of-7) | FUS `0x847B5c174615B1B7fDF770882256e2D3E95b9D92` |
| `sep/104-ink-sepolia-system-config-owner-to-fus` | Ink Sepolia (763373) | `0x05C993e60179f28bF649a2Bb5b00b5F4283bD525` | FOS `0x837DE453AD5F21E89771e3c06239d8236c0EFd5E` (2-of-N) | FUS `0xDEe57160aAfCF04c34C887B5962D0a69676d3C8B` |

Both use the existing `TransferSystemConfigOwnership` template; owner/nonce values verified on-chain at authoring (2026-08-04): both proxies are currently FOS-owned, FOS nonces pinned in `[stateOverrides]` (eth 121, sep 14).

**Policy note (per the ticket):** the FUS is the standard owner for all `SystemConfig` proxies going forward — recorded in both task READMEs. If there is a better home for this policy (e.g. ops runbooks / Notion), happy to document it there too.

## Verification

- `SIMULATE_WITHOUT_LEDGER=1 just simulate` passes for both tasks; domain/message/safe hashes recorded in each `VALIDATION.md`.
- `just simulate-stack eth` and `just simulate-stack sep` pass locally (CI-equivalent, including the VALIDATION.md hash gate).
- Re-verify FOS nonces before signing; regenerate hashes if they drift.

topPRs.title: eth/063: Swell Mainnet L1 ownership transfer to AltLayer
topPRs.author: ZakAyesh
topPRs.body:
## Description

Adds `eth/063-swell-l1-ownership-transfers`, executing the L1 half of the approved [Maintenance Upgrade Proposal: Swell Ownership Transfer to AltLayer](https://vote.optimism.io/proposals/55157120062626112833592164692393784963640643805353175342472662837980214398880) for Swell Mainnet (chainId 1923).

Using the `TransferOwners` template, the task transfers from the standard mainnet L1PAO Safe (`0x5a0Aae59D09fccBdDb6C6CcEB07B7279367C3d2A`) to AltLayer's Safe (`0xa83F1334c6a8Daca576Dc14020d9d2b1b16a8Dfa`, confirmed by AltLayer in #oplabs-altlayer — a 1-of-1 Safe with sole member `0x6967D304E9b7E26b5eb3f5A1FD1239DaAD3215E6`):

- ProxyAdmin (`0x4C4710a4Ec3F514A492CC6460818C4A6A6269dd6`) — `transferOwnership`
- DisputeGameFactoryProxy (`0x87690676786cDc8cCA75A472e483AF7C8F2f0F57`) — `transferOwnership` (part of the `TransferOwners` batch, matching precedent `eth/014` / `sep/097`)

Swell's DelayedWETH is v1.5.0 (post-U16) and not ownable, so the template skips it.

## Notes for reviewers

- Swell was removed from the superchain-registry ("Remove Arena-Z and Swell (sunsetting chains)"), so addresses load via `fallbackAddressesJsonPath`. Values were copied from the registry commit immediately before removal and verified on-chain.
- Safe nonce overrides are pinned at live values (read 2026-07-30: L1PAO=36 / FUS=62 / SC=60) **+2**, accounting for the READY-TO-SIGN `eth/061` and `eth/062` tasks signed by the same nested L1PAO. If those are reordered or cancelled, the hashes must be regenerated.
- Simulated successfully on both child-safe legs (`foundation`, `council`) with the repo-pinned forge 1.1.0; VALIDATION.md hashes come from those runs.
- Follow-up: the L2 ProxyAdmin transfer (`eth/064-swell-l2pao-transfer`) is submitted as a separate PR and stacks after this task.

Part of ethereum-optimism/solutions#980.

topPRs.title: Add Swell L1 ownership-transfer task (055)
topPRs.author: sbvegan
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds task `055-swell-l1-ownership-transfers`, which transfers **L1 ownership of the Swell chain (chainId 1923)** from the standard OP Mainnet L1PAO Safe (`0x5a0Aae59D09fccBdDb6C6CcEB07B7279367C3d2A`) to AltLayer's new owner Safe (`0xa83F1334c6a8Daca576Dc14020d9d2b1b16a8Dfa`). Swell is winding down and AltLayer is taking over to finish the wind-down.

Contracts moved via the `TransferOwners` template:
- **ProxyAdmin** (`0x4C4710a4Ec3F514A492CC6460818C4A6A6269dd6`) — `transferOwnership`
- **DisputeGameFactoryProxy** (`0x87690676786cDc8cCA75A472e483AF7C8F2f0F57`) — `transferOwnership`

The chain's DelayedWETH is v1.5.0 (post-U16) and not ownable, so the template skips it at build time. Swell has been removed from the public superchain-registry (ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry#1247); its addresses are loaded via `fallbackAddressesJsonPath` from `addresses.json` (verified with `op-fetcher`) and it reuses OP Mainnet's standard SuperchainConfig.

## Status

⚠️ **`DRAFT, NOT READY TO SIGN`** — requires Optimism Governance approval before signing. Domain/message hashes in `VALIDATION.md` were generated at task creation (2026-06-15) with pinned Safe nonces; live nonces must be re-verified and the task re-simulated before signing.
